gen-gf-oxanium-gf-fresca: Fresca is a modern plain sans with short ascenders over big bowls and no calligraphic thinning. And Oxanium grabs attention with its uninterrupted monoline strokes, while Fresca keeps its counters open to the outside.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans is a sans-serif with steady stroke widths from stem to curve and a lowercase e pried wide open. Oxanium commands attention, while Funnel Sans does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-golos-text: Golos Text is a contemporary plain sans whose x-height fills the line and whose s is widely parted. Golos Text lets Oxanium's commanding, monoline heading take the spotlight while it quietly carries the text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-heebo: Ribbon-cut strokes up top, a tall central band below: that is Oxanium over Heebo. Heebo, a sans with curves that stop short, would start competing with Oxanium if it were made large.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-siliguri: Commanding monoline letters up top, then a gentler, friendlier body beneath. Oxanium is built to be noticed, while Hind Siliguri hums along in a constant line weight with a gentle bump up to capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-karla: Unstressed curves up top, a gaping c opening below: Oxanium and Karla make a modern, approachable sans pairing. Karla's tall middle band makes paragraph after paragraph feel sturdy and stocky.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-khula: Stencil-cut letters of one steady width give Oxanium its commanding look. Khula, a modern sans with a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open, takes over for the reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-kufam: A very high x-height makes Oxanium's lowercase look big and commanding. Kufam, a plain sans with a neon-tube track width, can sit a little smaller because its bodies dominate the line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-lexend: Oxanium's uninterrupted monoline strokes give the heading its commanding edge. Lexend, a plain sans with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, is the one built for the actual reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-martel-sans: Distinctive monoline strokes run from top to baseline in Oxanium, while Martel Sans opens up every curve and holds a high mean line. Next to each other, one sounds loud and the other conversational.
